## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` because its hardcoded default violates the CLI policy and ignores CI configuration.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable filename-glob exclusions, skip logging, documentation, and parser and archive tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, your parser returns `[]`, so `.log` files enter the archive. For newly added flags, `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` requires they “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs configuring exclusions through the environment archive files they intended to omit. — Fix: Normalize the environment default into a pattern list and extend `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing` to cover a configured value.
